research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zynga is advancing in the realm of mobile and social gaming through several innovative developments. They are focusing on automated generation of custom game content, utilizing parametric values to tailor experiences to player behavior. Their research includes creating player models to enhance gameplay and predict user responses. Additionally, they are exploring touchscreen interfaces for intuitive user interaction and developing systems for dynamic game content generation. These efforts highlight Zynga's commitment to enhancing player engagement and personalizing gaming experiences.

overview_description.description: Zynga is a global leader in interactive entertainment with a mission to connect the world through games and a wholly-owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. With a massive global reach in more than 175 countries and regions, the combined diverse portfolio of popular game franchises has been downloaded more than 6 billion times on mobile, including CSR Racing™, Dragon City™, Empires & Puzzles™, FarmVille™, Golf Rival™, Hair Challenge™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, High Heels!™, Merge Dragons!™, Merge Magic!™, Monster Legends™, Toon Blast™, Top Eleven™, Toy Blast™, Two Dots™, Words With Friends™, and Zynga Poker™. Zynga is also an industry-leading next-generation platform with the ability to optimize programmatic advertising and yields at scale with Chartboost, a leading mobile advertising and monetization platform. Founded in 2007, Zynga is headquartered in California with locations in North America, Europe, and Asia.

about_short_description.short_description: Zynga is a mobile game developer that creates and operates social games as live services played on the Internet.

product.name: Zynga Mobile Games Portfolio
product.description: A portfolio of free-to-play mobile and social games spanning farming, puzzles, word games, card games, racing, sports, role-playing, strategy, and casino genres.

product.name: FarmVille
product.description: A farming simulation game in which players cultivate crops, raise animals, expand farms, and participate in social and seasonal activities.

product.name: Words With Friends
product.description: A social word game that lets players compete in turn-based word matches and complete solo word puzzles on mobile and digital platforms.

product.name: Zynga Poker
product.description: A free-to-play social poker game offering online Texas Hold’em-style play, multiplayer tables, tournaments, and player progression.

product.name: CSR Racing 2
product.description: A mobile drag-racing game focused on collecting, customizing, upgrading, and racing licensed high-performance cars against live competitors.

product.name: Merge Dragons!
product.description: A puzzle and progression game where players combine objects, develop a dragon-filled world, complete levels, and collect rewards.
